description: Software Engineers design, develop, and maintain complex software systems. To beat the ATS, a software engineer resume must precisely balance technical skills with demonstrable business impact.
atsRecommendations: Include a dedicated Technical Skills section grouped by languages, frameworks, and tools.
Spell out acronyms at least once (e.g., 'Amazon Web Services (AWS)').

description: Data Analysts turn raw data into actionable business intelligence. An ATS-optimized data analyst resume must showcase proficiency in SQL, data visualization, and statistical analysis.
atsRecommendations: Explicitly mention the BI tools you used in each role.
Focus on the business outcomes of your analyses (e.g., 'Increased revenue by 15%').
Include statistical methods as keywords if mentioned in the job description.
